verdict.rationale: Parsec's downloads page lists a 'Web Google Chrome' platform, which suggests a first-party browser client. Link-based sharing lets a team member observe or take control of a session. However, nothing documents that the web client needs zero installation, works in browsers other than Chrome, or that shared-link guests can join from a browser. missing for 10: explicit no-install browser access, support beyond Chrome, documentation tying link-based view/control to the web client, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, someone can view or control a session from a plain browser with nothing installed

citations.quote: share a link, and a team member can observe or even take control of your computer.
